items.item: A stepper names each step and lets the user go back to earlier steps
items.evidence: stepper(): STEPS = Upload, Map columns, Review, Import in <nav aria-label="Import progress"><ol>; completed steps render as button[data-act=goto] (canClick when done && S.file && S.step<3); also Back buttons in bar().

items.item: Column mapping auto-matches headers and marks required target fields
items.evidence: autoMap(headers) matches via headerKey() against label and aliases (Vietnamese diacritics folded); stepMap() shows 'Required fields' list, options suffixed ' *', and 'Columns were matched by name where possible'; remembered mapping via localStorage.

items.item: The preview table shows per-row errors and an error count, and offers to download the failing rows
items.evidence: reviewTable() marks error cells (bg-red-50, alert icon, title msg) and a Result column with first error '(+N more)'; stepReview() shows '${errN} rows have errors', summary line 'N with errors', 'Errors only (N)' filter, and button data-act=dl-failed 'Download failed rows (N)' -> failedCsv().

items.item: The import shows progress, can continue in the background, and ends with a summary of created, updated and failed rows
items.evidence: stepImport(): role=progressbar with 'Importing X of Y (pct%)', 'Run in background' button (data-act=bg) with banner() and bell notification on finish; final view shows figures Created / Updated / Skipped / Failed, resultLine(), and import log.

items.item: The flow runs on a page or a full-width panel, not inside a small modal
items.evidence: Rendered in <main> with breadcrumb, h1 'Import products' and content in 'max-w-6xl' panel; the only <dialog> is used for leave/stop confirmations.

items.item: A template file is offered for download before upload
items.evidence: stepUpload(): section '1. Download the template' with button data-act=template 'Download template (CSV, UTF-8 with BOM)' plus column guide table, placed before '2. Upload your file'.

notes: Clean, restrained admin UI: light slate sidebar, single blue accent, 4/8px radii, no gradients/glass/emoji, sentence-case labels, text-and-icon status badges. Audit score 100 with no violations. The 'NK' tile is a company logo mark and 'LH' is a real user, so not flagged as non-person initials avatars. Minor: the first viewport shows only the template step and the upload dropzone sits below the fold, but this is not a checklist failure.
